about_the_game:
"Be Rich Or Good" – A Commercial Labyrinth of Choices and Redemption

A conspiracy strips the protagonist Shane of everything, and eight years later, he infiltrates Yongqiang Group under a pseudonym, navigating the whirlpool of power and truth to seek answers.

Deep Interactive Narrative

Every choice you make shapes the story’s branching paths, unlocking over 20+ endings and letting you experience drastically different fates.

Workplace Strategic Gameplay

Thrive in the complex web of corporate relationships. Gain critical permissions through dialogues, missions, and decisions to inch closer to the core secrets.

Cinematic Immersive Experience

A dynamic feedback system and meticulously designed character interactions deliver a narrative experience that pulls you into the story.

Ideal for Players Who Enjoy:

  • Plot-driven storytelling

  • Strategic decision-making

  • Exploring multiple endings

This immersive journey blends corporate intrigue with moral dilemmas, where your every move determines how Shane’s quest for redemption unfolds.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may not be suitable for all age groups. Some content includes:

Crime: Kidnapping, violence (fight scenes)
Sexual content: Revealing clothing (camisole pajamas), nude loans, nude photo shooting
Legal drugs: Alcohol consumption, smoking, legal painkillers
Illegal drugs: References to illegal drugs ("obedient pills")
